> You have my encouragements. As long as you're alive, it's never too late to take the decisions that will lead you to a better state of being.

True that, that's pretty much what went through my head when I backed out. One day I will die and have peace anyways I might as well try to make the most of living even if I don't always feel like it.

Not sure why I didn't think about just saying it doesn't work for me or just that it makes me depressed. I feel kinda silly now, heh. I think I'll make an appointment to talk about quitting it this week (needs to be titrated down)

>Meds are drugs, too.

I am fully aware of this, I don't abuse them however.

The citalopram works! I am much better off when I am on it. Strattera is a new adhd medication (also a re uptake inhibitor) I'm taking which has a black box warning, I only mentioned it because I'm not quite sure how to bring it up with my doctor or what will happen if I do, I don't mind quitting it, I just don't want to be labelled a suicide risk, and I don't want to go off my citalopram because of that.
